task.title: P6-095: Fix collapsible padding leaking height when closed
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-095. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**A vendored `collapsible`'s `class` padding leaks height when closed** — the prop lands on the inner div, and `min-h-0` zeroes its content box but not its padding, so `class="pt-1"` leaves a visible sliver of open track under every collapsed row (found on `/my`'s location summary, worked around by moving the padding onto the child). Either apply `class` to the clipped region or document the constraint on the prop; the existing workaround suggests documenting is enough.
